    Forecast Dock Availability at User Arrival

    predict_dock.Rd

    Uses smoothed typical-week docking profiles to estimate net inventory changes over the user's travel time, projecting available bikes and free spaces upon arrival.

    predict_dock(
  rates,
  dock,
  live_bikes,
  capacity,
  walk_min,
  now = Sys.time(),
  smooth_min = 30,
  bin_minutes = 5,
  tz = "America/Chicago"
)

    Arguments

    rates

    Data frame of historical rates produced by compute_dock_rates().

    dock

    Station identifier string (DOCID).

    live_bikes

    Numeric count of bikes currently docked at departure time.

    capacity

    Total docking slot capacity at the station.

    walk_min

    Numeric travel time to the dock in minutes.

    now

    Departure timestamp (default: Sys.time()).

    smooth_min

    Minutes for moving-average smoothing of weekly profile (default: 30).

    bin_minutes

    Bin size in minutes (default: 5).

    tz

    City timezone string (default: "America/Chicago").

    Value

    Named numeric vector with expected_bikes, expected_spaces, and change.
